display_long_description:
**Jamsesh is THE next-gen music game. Your stage, your spotlight!** 

Join the jam. Jump into the Jamsesh discord → https://discord.gg/jamsesh

With weekly updates, there’s always something new in Jamsesh! 

##
#  🎶 Play to music with instruments
##

Experience what it’s like to be a star! Choose drums, guitar or microphone and perform on stage to an audience of thousands! 


[media]
##
# 🎸Create bands with friends
##
Hang with friends, find bandmates and create and customise your own bands.  Perform together, build your fame, and  discover new bandmates - perform & unlock gear. 

Jump on stage — go solo or pull up to the social lobby and meet your next bandmates

[media]

##
# Free. To. Play. 
##
There’s no price for entry; collectibles and gear are there if you wanna flex

[media]
##
# Custom instruments and outfits
##
Design your look — create your own star persona and an identity for you and your band


[media]
